hero.text: A quadcopter designed, wired, coded and test-flown by Team Zero Byte — from the first sketch to the first stable hover.

about.text: We set out to build a drone that is stable, smart and simple to fly. Every part — the frame, the flight controller tuning, the camera mount — was chosen, tested and refined by the team.

parts.title: Brushless motors
parts.text: Four motors with two-blade props for lift and fast response.

parts.title: Stabilised camera
parts.text: Nose-mounted gimbal keeps footage level in flight.

parts.title: Lightweight frame
parts.text: Stiff X-layout arms and landing skids.

parts.title: GPS & battery
parts.text: Top-mounted GPS and a rear slide-in battery pack.

features.title: Stable hover
features.text: Tuned PID loops keep the drone locked in place, even in a breeze.

features.title: GPS position hold
features.text: Return-to-home and waypoint flight from onboard GPS.

features.title: Stabilised camera
features.text: A gimbal-mounted camera for smooth aerial footage.

features.title: Custom frame
features.text: Lightweight frame designed and assembled in-house.

features.title: Live telemetry
features.text: Battery, altitude and signal streamed to the ground in real time.

features.title: Fail-safes
features.text: Low-battery and signal-loss protection bring it home safely.
